nodes.label: Claude Code Agent
nodes.rationale: Preferred for feature implementation, UI building, components, and refactoring; risks include overbuilding and PRD drift; controlled by single-milestone prompts

nodes.label: Codex Agent
nodes.rationale: Used after each Claude Code milestone for TypeScript review, broken imports, unsafe Electron patterns, and minimal fixes; risk is premature architecture changes

nodes.label: Project Health Score Logic
nodes.rationale: Session logging integrated into health: null lastSession → 'No session logged yet', stale lastSession → 'Last session was X days ago', fresh → 'Recent session logged'. Numeric percentage deferred per §14.

nodes.label: Prompt Generation Feature
nodes.rationale: Pure function generatePrompt with no side effects; empty fields omitted (no dashes); doNotChangeRules sorted Hard Rule first; no AI/API calls

nodes.label: MVP Project Tracking Loop
nodes.rationale: Core UX loop: See project → Understand progress → Know next step → Choose agent → Do the work → Update project. Everything else deferred until this loop works well.

nodes.label: Manual Session Logging Feature
nodes.rationale: One slot only (no history list); pre-populates date with today and agent with project.recommendedAgent; updates lastWorkedOn and lastAgentUsed on save

nodes.label: Coding Agent Protocol
nodes.rationale: Before-during-after protocol: pre-coding plan required, smallest effective change during, end-of-session summary with changes/files/known issues/recommended next task
